alt: 路人的購物袋破了，青年停下腳步蹲著撿蔬菜，並遞出自己的備用袋。
scene_prompt: On a modern neighborhood sidewalk, a kind passerby spontaneously stops to help an unfamiliar elderly person whose grocery bag has split. The helper kneels to gather rolling vegetables and offers a spare sturdy bag; the elder looks relieved and grateful. Other belongings and walking direction show a chance encounter. Warm active assistance, natural anatomy.
